artifacts.title: Swarmer launch post for Vectus Air Defense Systems
artifacts.author: Swarmer
artifacts.notes: Transcribed from a user-provided screenshot. The fixture preserves the visible claims but does not treat the post as performance evidence.

locator.quotedText: We are incredibly proud to launch Vectus Air Defense Systems

evidence.statement: Swarmer publicly names and launches an offering called Vectus Air Defense Systems.
limitations: No exact product or service version is stated.

evidence.statement: Swarmer claims the offering is designed to protect high-value sites.
limitations: The protected-site class, threat set, geometry, duration, and success threshold are not specified.

locator.quotedText: integrating proven detection, electronic warfare, and interceptor technologies into one managed service

evidence.statement: Swarmer describes detection, electronic warfare, interceptors, and managed operation as the offering mechanism.
limitations: The post does not identify component models, interfaces, staffing, authorization, or a measured system configuration.
The word proven is claimant language, not independent verification.

locator.quotedText: operating at a fraction of the cost of legacy systems

evidence.statement: Swarmer claims the managed service operates at a fraction of the cost of legacy systems.
limitations: No legacy comparator, numerical price, accounting period, staffing model, or cost boundary is supplied.

claims.statement: The launch artifact names the offering Vectus Air Defense Systems.
Vectus is designed to protect high-value sites from proliferating aerial threats.
limitations: This is an advertised outcome, not an observed result.

claims.statement: Vectus integrates detection, electronic warfare, interceptors, and managed operation.
